name: The Collector's Schedule
summary: Near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, The Collector's Schedule marks when illicit gold shipments move through Elwynn Forest. Gnolls carry the handwritten itinerary, and Marshal Dughan recognizes the name it records.

sections.title: Stolen Gold and Secret Shipments
sections.body: The Collector's Schedule marks dates and times for gold shipments from Elwynn's mines. Stormwind has not officially worked the mines for months, driven off by banditry and creature incursions, yet ore still leaves in an orderly flow. The itinerary names the days and hours when a figure called The Collector receives each shipment. The trail points to a camp near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn Forest. When Marshal Dughan sees the schedule, he recognizes the Collector's name. Who pays for the stolen gold remains unknown.

faq.answer: The Collector's Schedule records when gold shipments leave Elwynn Forest's abandoned mines for an operative called The Collector.

faq.q: Where did the schedule come from?
faq.answer: Gnolls carry the schedule along Elwynn Forest's riverbanks and hillsides. They may have taken it from a courier or may be involved in moving the gold.
The Collector is an agent stationed near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn Forest. Marshal Dughan recognizes the name but does not know whom the agent serves.

faq.q: Why is Marshal Dughan alarmed by this schedule?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan is alarmed because Stormwind has had no official miners in Elwynn's mines for months, yet substantial gold shipments still leave them. That points to an organized, illicit mining operation within the kingdom.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can see how little control Stormwind has over its own territory when unauthorized crews take its resources near the capital.
As a miner, you can see that Elwynn's mines are not idle: rich gold veins are being stripped and hauled away.
